Data and limitations

NASA SVS · LROC and LOLA

NASA · LCROSS impact site

LPI · Clementine composition

Global LOLA terrain is sampled at 4 points/degree. Local tiles use 16 points/degree (about 1.9 km at the equator). Source terrain and imagery have different resolutions.

Coordinates use east-positive longitude on a 1737.4 km lunar reference sphere. Local terrain may be interpolated. Resource maps are published color visualizations; no pixel-level abundance readout is available.

Sky uses Astronomy Engine and a bundled d3-celestial bright-star catalog. Terrain shadows are optional; orbit and illumination are approximate. Time controls cover 1900–2100. This viewer has no operational navigation validation.
